item.text:
**7B.5**
- **Bottom line:** Mixed, leaning **positive on competence** but with clear evidence of **loyalist/security inner-circle placement**. I found no reliable 2024 evidence of family/donor/business cronyism; the strongest record is about merit vs party/security loyalty.

**Evidence For Competence**
- [Ethiopian parliament approves new cabinet members](https://english.news.cn/africa/20240208/98ce6131a6cd4bbc9987c5d32fd4062e/c.html) | Xinhua | 2024-02-08 | Abiy said Temesgen Tiruneh, Taye Atske Selassie, and Mekdes Daba were chosen for rich experience; the release also says Temesgen was not just a partisan pick, while Taye and Mekdes were explicitly described as experienced professionals. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3
- [House Approves Temesgen Tiruneh as Deputy Premier, Ambassador Taye Foreign Minister](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_3985658) | ENA | 2024-02-08 | Parliament unanimously approved Temesgen and Taye after Abiy presented their credentials, and the official line emphasized service experience and competence. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3
- [Mekdes Daba nommé nouveau ministre de la santé](https://www.ena.et/web/fre/w/fre_3987383) | ENA | 2024-02-08 | The health minister appointment highlights Mekdes Daba’s professional credentials and FIGO recognition, supporting a technocratic reading for at least one major ministry. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3
- [Ethiopia’s House of Peoples Representatives Approves Appointment of Five Ministers](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5370293) | ENA | 2024-10-29 | The House approved five ministers and the ruling explanation was that the new appointees were young officials who had already proven their abilities in practice. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3
- [The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia: Request of an Arrangement Under the Extended Credit Facility](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/07/29/the-federal-democratic-republic-of-ethiopia-request-of-an-arrangement-under-the-extended-552778) | IMF | 2024-07-29 | The reform team is presented as technocratic and rule-based, with professionalized SOE governance, government-independent directors, and an independent NBE supervisor. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3

**Evidence Against**
- [Ethiopia intelligence head Temesgen approved as deputy prime minister](https://ca.news.yahoo.com/ethiopia-intelligence-head-temesgen-approved-070230642.html) | Reuters | 2024-02-08 | Temesgen Tiruneh, the intelligence chief and ruling-party vice president, was moved to deputy PM, while Redwan Hussein moved from national security adviser to NISS chief. That looks like a tighter security inner circle, not broad professionalization. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.1
- [Brewing reform, or routine reshuffle?](https://www.thereporterethiopia.com/38653/) | The Reporter | 2024-02-10 | Opposition voices argued the reshuffle was about consolidating loyalty, and the editorial says Ethiopia’s ruling-party tradition has favored loyalty over merit. | QIDs: 7B.5
- [News: Reuters investigation reveals secretive security committee tasked with crushing dissent in Oromia](https://addisstandard.com/news-reuters-investigation-reveals-secretive-security-committee-tasked-with-crushing-dissent-in-oromia-region/) | Addis Standard / Reuters report | 2024-02-24 | The Koree Nageenyaa committee appears to be a parallel coercive structure tied to senior officials, which is consistent with governance through loyal security networks rather than neutral institutions. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.1
- [Ethiopia halt crackdown against human rights groups](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/ethiopia-halt-crackdown-against-human-rights-groups) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-06-18 | Rights workers were reportedly followed, intimidated, and threatened by security and intelligence personnel, which undercuts the idea that Abiy was filling the state with independent professionals insulated from political control. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.1
- [Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-02 | Abiy praised reform rhetoric while the government kept punishing watchdogs, suggesting selective use of state power and loyalty enforcement rather than neutral administration. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.1

**Gap**
- I found **no reliable 2024 evidence** that Abiy’s family or business associates were directly installed into top government posts, or that a documented donor/cronies network dominated appointments. The strongest evidence is instead about **party loyalty vs technocratic competence**, especially in security and top cabinet posts.
